text:
```yaml
name: Labeler

on:
  issues:
    types: [opened, edited]
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, edited, synchronize]

jobs:
  label:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Determine task ID
        id: set_task_id
        run: |
          if [ "${{ github.event_name }}" = "issues" ]; then
            echo "taskId=${{ github.event.issue.number }}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "taskId=${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Run labeler action
        uses: ./.github/actions/labeler
        with:
          taskId: ${{ steps.set_task_id.outputs.taskId }}
```

    types: [opened, edited, synchronize]

          if [ "${{ github.event_name }}" = "issues" ]; then
            echo "taskId=${{ github.event.issue.number }}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
